figures.quote: Revenus inférieurs à 9 612 € (20 % du plafond annuel de la Sécurité sociale - Pass) 0 %

figures.quote: Revenus compris entre 9 612 € et 19 224 € (entre 20 % et 40 % du Pass)

figures.item: Third step of the self-employed health scale in 2026 (60% of the annual ceiling): up to this figure the rate rises from 1.50% to 4%.
figures.quote: Revenus compris entre 19 224 € et 28 836 € (entre 40 % et 60 % du Pass)

figures.item: Fourth step of the self-employed health scale in 2026 (110% of the annual ceiling): up to this figure the rate rises from 4% to 6.50%.
figures.quote: Revenus compris entre 28 836 € et 52 866 € (entre 60 % et 110 % du Pass)

figures.quote: Revenus compris entre 52 866 € et 96 120 € (entre 110 % et 200 % du Pass)

figures.item: Sixth step of the self-employed health scale in 2026 (300% of the annual ceiling): up to this figure the rate rises from 7.70% to 8.50%, which is the full rate.
figures.quote: Revenus compris entre 96 120 € et 144 180 € (entre 200 % et 300 % du Pass)

figures.quote: Le nouveau taux « plein » est fixé à 8,5 % pour l’ensemble des travailleurs indépendants

figures.quote: Part des revenus supérieure 144 180 € (300 % du Pass) 6,50 %

figures.quote: Dans la limite de 240 300 € (5 plafonds annuel de la Sécurité sociale - Pass) 0,50 %

figures.item: Income cap for the daily sickness benefit contribution of a self-employed worker in 2026: 5 annual social security ceilings.
figures.quote: Dans la limite de 240 300 € (5 plafonds annuel de la Sécurité sociale - Pass)

figures.item: Basic state pension contribution of a craftsman, trader or unregulated liberal profession in 2026, on income up to one annual ceiling.

figures.quote: Part du revenus compris entre 48 060 € et 192 240 € (entre 1 et 4 Pass) 9,10 %

figures.quote: Sur la base de 48 060 € (1 plafond annuel de la Sécurité sociale - Pass) 0,29 %

figures.quote: Sur la base de 48 060 € (1 plafond annuel de la Sécurité sociale - Pass) 0,34 %

figures.item: Minimum share capital of a societe par actions simplifiee (SAS). The partners set the amount freely, with this as the floor. A SARL has no minimum at all; a SA has EUR 37,000.
figures.quote: Le montant du capital social est déterminé librement par les associés ( 1 € minimum)

figures.item: A SAS must have at least half of a cash contribution paid up at incorporation; the other half must be paid within this period after registration. A SARL needs only 20% at incorporation, with the same 5-year balance period.
figures.quote: L'autre moitié doit être libérée dans les 5 ans qui suivent l'immatriculatio

figures.item: Share of a cash contribution to a SARL that must be paid up when the company is created. The balance must be paid within 5 years of registration.
figures.quote: 20 % des apports lors de la création de la société

figures.item: Maximum number of partners in a SARL. The minimum is 2; with a single partner it is an EURL.
figures.quote: qui doit compter au moins 2 associés , et au maximum 100 associés

figures.item: Value above which a contribution in kind to a SARL must be valued by a contribution auditor (commissaire aux apports). The partners can skip the auditor only if they agree unanimously AND no single contribution in kind is worth more than this AND the contributions in kind together are not more than half the share capital. All three, not any one.
figures.quote: Aucun des apports en nature n'a une valeur supérieure à 30 000 €

figures.item: Minimum share capital of a societe anonyme (SA). Contributions in kind must always be valued by a contribution auditor, and contributions in industry are forbidden.
figures.quote: doit être au minimum de 37 000 €

figures.item: Minimum number of shareholders in a SA: 2, or 7 if it is listed. There is no maximum.
figures.quote: Ses actionnaires, au nombre minimum de 2 (ou 7 si elle est côtée en bourse)

figures.item: Compulsory transfer to the legal reserve out of each year's profit. The legal reserve cannot be distributed.
figures.quote: Elle est constituée par un prélèvement d'au moins 5 % réalisé sur le bénéfice de chaque exercice

figures.item: Level at which the transfer to the legal reserve stops being compulsory: the reserve reaches this share of the share capital.
figures.quote: Ce prélèvement cesse d'être obligatoire lorsque la réserve légale atteint 10 % du capital social

figures.item: Balance sheet total under which a commercial company counts as a micro-enterprise for annual accounts purposes. Two of the three micro criteria must be met. Raised by the 2024 uplift of the accounting size thresholds.
figures.quote: Bilan total inférieur ou égal à 450 000 €

figures.item: Net turnover under which a commercial company counts as a micro-enterprise for annual accounts purposes.
figures.quote: Montant net du chiffre d'affaires inférieur ou égal à 900 000 €

figures.item: Average headcount under which a commercial company counts as a micro-enterprise for annual accounts purposes. A micro-enterprise may skip the notes to the accounts and may file its accounts confidentially.
figures.quote: Nombre moyen de salariés employés au cours de l'année inférieur ou égal à 10

figures.item: Balance sheet total under which a commercial company counts as a small enterprise for annual accounts purposes. Two of the three criteria must be met.
figures.quote: Bilan total inférieur ou égal à 7 500 000 €

figures.item: Net turnover excluding VAT under which a commercial company counts as a small enterprise for annual accounts purposes.
figures.quote: Montant net HT du chiffre d'affaires inférieur ou égal à 15 000 000 €

figures.item: Average headcount under which a commercial company counts as a small enterprise for annual accounts purposes. A small enterprise may present its accounts in simplified form.
figures.quote: Nombre moyen de salariés employés au cours de l'année inférieur ou égal à 50

figures.item: Balance sheet total under which a commercial company counts as a medium-sized enterprise for annual accounts purposes.
figures.quote: Bilan total inférieur ou égal à 25 000 000 €

figures.item: Net turnover excluding VAT under which a commercial company counts as a medium-sized enterprise for annual accounts purposes.
figures.quote: Montant net HT du chiffre d'affaires inférieur ou égal à 50 000 000 €

figures.item: Average headcount under which a commercial company counts as a medium-sized enterprise for annual accounts purposes. Above these figures the company is a large enterprise; this page gives no separate large-enterprise figures.
figures.quote: Nombre moyen de salariés employés au cours de l'année inférieur ou égal à 250

figures.item: How the accounting size categories are applied: the company must meet two of the three criteria. The page states the test this way and does not state a consecutive-years rule for these accounting categories.
figures.quote: si elle remplit 2 des 3 critères suivants

figures.item: How long a commercial company must keep its accounting records and supporting documents, counted from the close of the financial year.
figures.quote: au moins 10 ans à partir de la clôture de l'exercice comptable

figures.item: Fine a company faces for not keeping its accounting documents for the required period.
figures.quote: s'expose à une amende de 10 000 €

figures.item: Turnover limit for the simplified real regime, which lets a company keep simplified books and file simplified accounts, for selling, catering and providing accommodation. A TAX limit as well: the tax family of the pack holds it too.
figures.quote: 945 000 € pour les activités de vente, de restauration ou de mise à disposition de logement

figures.item: Turnover limit for the simplified real regime for other activities.
figures.quote: 286 000 € pour les autres activités

figures.quote: Le montant de la TVA dont elle est redevable est inférieur à 15 000 €

figures.item: Balance sheet total which, with one other of the three, makes appointing a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) compulsory for a SARL, EURL, SA, SAS or SCA. Two of the three thresholds must be crossed.
figures.quote: 5 000 000 € de total bilan

figures.item: Turnover excluding VAT which, with one other of the three, makes appointing a statutory auditor compulsory.
figures.quote: 10 000 000 € de chiffre d'affaires HT

figures.item: Headcount which, with one other of the three, makes appointing a statutory auditor compulsory.
figures.quote: 10 000 000 € de chiffre d'affaires HT 50 salariés

figures.quote: dès lors que 2 des 3 seuils suivants sont franchis

figures.item: Length of a statutory auditor's mandate when the appointment is compulsory. A voluntary appointment runs 3 years.
figures.quote: 6 ans renouvelable ou 3 ans en cas de désignation volontaire

figures.item: Fine for failing to appoint a statutory auditor when the law requires one, on top of a prison term of 2 years.
figures.quote: passible d'un emprisonnement de 2 ans et d'une amende de 30 000 €

figures.item: Share of the capital that lets one or more partners ask a judge to appoint a statutory auditor even below the thresholds. The judge is free to refuse.
figures.quote: un ou plusieurs associés représentant au moins 10 % du capital peuvent demander au juge

figures.quote: s'expose à une amende pénale de 1 500 €

figures.item: Criminal fine on the director for a repeat failure to file the annual accounts.
figures.quote: En cas de récidive, l'amende passe à 3 000 €
